headerDisplay: The **Homebridge Resideo** plugin allows you to control Resideo thermostats and also view your Leak and Room Sensors from HomeKit. To get started link your Resideo account using the Dynamic UI below.
footerDisplay: Your Resideo account has been linked. Device configuration is handled through the Dynamic UI. Please raise any issues on our [project page](https://github.com/homebridge-plugins/homebridge-resideo/issues).

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name that will appear in your Homebridge log.

credentials.title: Resideo API Credentials
credentials.description: Your Resideo developer account credentials for API access.

consumerKey.title: Consumer Key
consumerKey.description: Your Resideo developer account Consumer Key.

consumerSecret.title: Consumer Secret
consumerSecret.description: Your Resideo developer account Consumer Secret.

options.title: Global Settings
options.description: Platform-wide configuration options. Device-specific settings are configured through the Dynamic UI.

refreshRate.title: Default Refresh Rate (seconds)
refreshRate.description: How often to poll the Resideo API for device updates (minimum 30 seconds).

pushRate.title: Default Push Rate (seconds)
pushRate.description: Minimum time between commands sent to the Resideo API.

logging.title: Global Logging Level
logging.description: Set the logging level for the entire platform.

allowInvalidCharacters.title: Allow Invalid Characters in Names
allowInvalidCharacters.description: Allow special characters in device names that might cause issues in HomeKit.

layout.helpvalue:
First-Time Setup

This plugin uses a modern Dynamic UI powered by homebridge-plugin-utils for device configuration.

Manual Configuration: If you need to manually configure credentials, expand the section below. Otherwise, use the Dynamic UI for a guided setup experience.

items.helpvalue: Note: These credentials can be configured automatically through the Dynamic UI. Manual setup is only recommended for advanced users.
These settings apply to all devices. Individual device configuration is handled through the Dynamic UI.

layout.helpvalue:
Device Configuration

All device-specific settings (hide devices, thermostat options, room sensor settings, etc.) are now configured through the Dynamic UI above.

The Dynamic UI provides an intuitive interface for:

  • Device discovery and selection
  • Individual device configuration
  • Feature options management
  • Real-time device status
